title: Hi, I’m Reinout
text:
Hi, I’m Reinout
I’m a 2nd-year Master’s student at UHasselt in Statistics & Data Science, specializing in the Bioinformatics track. My main interests are genetics, evolutionary biology, and anything related to animals.
I enjoy exploring data, building predictive models, and creating clear and engaging visualizations using R, Python, JavaScript, and React.
In my free time, I like to:
- Go to the gym
- Cook and experiment in the kitchen
- Play the mouth harmonica
- Learn about horses and other random topics
You can also find me online: GitHub | LinkedIn
